beats.event: Ten guests invited to a lonely island off the Devon coast
Gramophone plays voice accusing each guest of a killing
Anthony Marston collapses dead from cyanide-laced drink
Mrs Rogers found dead in her bed next morning
General MacArthur killed by a blow to the head
Guests conclude one of the seven survivors is the killer
Mr Rogers axed at the woodpile; Emily Brent poisoned
Wargrave orders drugs and firearms locked away
Vera screams at seaweed dangling in her bedroom
Wargrave found shot in a mock judge's wig and robe
Blore sees a figure in the night; Armstrong vanishes
A marble bear clock falls from Vera's window sill, kills Blore
Vera and Lombard find Armstrong's drowned body on beach
Vera grabs Lombard's gun and shoots him dead
Alone, mind unravelling, Vera hangs herself from a noose
Bottled confession later reveals Wargrave staged everything
